entities.summary: Mike Edwards is an American professional football safety for the Kansas City Chiefs of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kentucky Wildcats, and was selected by the Buccaneers in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. He won Super Bowl LV with Tampa Bay in 2020 and Super Bowl LVIII with the Kansas City Chiefs in 2023.
